name: 3P: characteristic sets of rank-3 matroids
goal: For each matroid M in the family, chi(M) fully held: its characteristic-0 status, its exceptional prime set, and a held status at each exceptional prime.
admitted_moves: C1/C3 ideal certificates over Q, or mod p (a rational identity whose residual vanishes mod p), optionally on selected guards
C2 points over Q, or over F_p
proper_coefficient: a single equation with a nonzero (mod p: unit) coefficient at a non-constant monomial
rules r1, inclusion, map, split, cover, bridge

encoding.premise: ENCODING-FRAME (OPEN): M is realizable over K iff the framed system is nonempty over K
encoding.note: M is realizable over some field of characteristic p iff the system is geometrically nonempty there: NOT_IN_IDEAL(1) at characteristic p (ACF_p). EMPTY at p means realizable over no field of characteristic p. NONEMPTY at p is stronger: a point in every field of characteristic p, so it needs a point over the prime field; the bridge rule turns NONEMPTY into NOT_IN_IDEAL(1).

done: Every M has chi(M) fully held, or each open item is tagged `closable in principle` or `no complete method`.

family.purpose: about 10 named rank-3 matroids whose characteristic sets a primary source states
family.selection: The campaign agent chooses them, writes each to matroids/<name>.json with "name", "elements", "lines" and "source" (citation and stated answer, tagged [VERIFY] until checked). Include non-Pappus, whose characteristic set should be empty.

family.purpose: stretch: all simple rank-3 matroids on at most 8 elements from a catalog
family.selection: The generator is labelled trusted and catalog completeness is an OPEN premise. Go to 9 elements only if F2 is cheap. No COUNT claim over the catalog before G4.

logs.cost: cost-log.jsonl (campaigns/schemas/cost-log.schema.json), one entry per task, from day one
logs.friction: friction-log.jsonl (campaigns/schemas/friction-log.schema.json), every refusal classified useful, false or ergonomic
